EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 2
EPISODE LOGLINE: The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, long thought drowned, and he offers Mara a bargain: marry him to clear her name.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Corin has a scar along his jaw. The hall is now spelled Marrowynd Hall in the notes. Selene wears a green gown.
